name: agent-webmcp
description: Operate Agent WebMCP's canonical service, agent, discovery, and durable-job workflows while preserving its bounded MCP and WebMCP authority surfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Operate bounded local services, agents, discovery, and durable jobs
interface.longDescription: Understand and use Agent WebMCP's 23-operation canonical runtime, its 18-tool browser-native WebMCP projection, and its intentionally narrower 16-tool remote MCP projection. The skill covers managed-service inspection and lifecycle, deterministic and optional Codex-assisted discovery, durable service jobs, runtime Agent Registry monitoring, and the Fleet Cockpit MCP App reached through a dedicated Agent WebMCP Secure MCP Tunnel.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current Agent WebMCP system, agents, and managed-service health.
Discover operator services safely and explain which candidates were accepted or rejected.
Inspect durable Agent WebMCP jobs, their execution trace, logs, and agent attribution.
